name: null
note: pure noise; no carrier. Expect max |T| consistent with the extreme of NCHAN x NDRIFT standard normals.

name: stationary_5sigma
note: stationary carrier at 5 sigma per-integration-stacked amplitude, centred in one channel. Expect T ~ 5 at zero drift, and a loss of ~sqrt(2) at half-channel offset.

name: drifting_5sigma
note: carrier drifting by four channels across the track. Expect T ~ 5 ONLY at the matching drift trial; stacking at zero drift must lose approximately sqrt(NINT/4).

name: drifting_offgrid
note: drift falling between two trial rates. Expect the recovered amplitude to be reduced relative to the on-grid case; this is the grid-loss term the completeness curve must capture.
